title: Introduction to the Salafi Dawah
description: What is the Salafi Dawah? An introduction to the methodology of calling to Islam upon the understanding of the Salaf (the righteous predecessors): pure tawheed, following the Qur'an and Sunnah, gentleness in dawah, and the importance of knowledge. The complete 8-part series by Abu Khadeejah Abdul-Wahid, plus the printed work 'The Call to Allah' by Shaykh Salih al-Fawzan (free distribution with attribution, no profit).
short_description: The Salafi methodology of dawah, explained
